Run2 case108 NEW frozen answer Q2: No. A bot-assigned Editor who is an ordinary platform viewer experiences normal waits; the bot role alone does not grant platform-moderator bypass. To reproduce normal waits, use an eligible account that is neither platform broadcaster nor platform moderator, with enough command access. The bot must be connected and running, the command enabled, the trigger correct, and the stream live unless offline commands are enabled. Independent source check: Stored Editor can confer access but does not bypass incoming-platform cooldowns; ordinary eligible non-broadcaster/non-platform-moderator account reproduces waits. A positive Minimum bits setting blocks the speech; moderator approval can hold it in a queue the current dashboard cannot review.
